title: サウジアラビアRCにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the start of the Saudi Arabia R.C., the student council's general manager comes to wish Symboli Rudolf well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rudolf instructs the manager to watch her performance in the race, and the manager nods. With that, Rudolf departs for the race full of confidence.
